summary: Task A — Claude classify measure in shadow pairs; frozen human-labelled T3 eval

tests.command:
bash -c '/usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/compound-v-classify-request.py --selftest >/dev/null && /usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/compound-v-jev.py --selftest >/dev/null && echo floor-ok'
/usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/lint-frontmatter.py .
bash -c 'shellcheck hooks/*.sh && bash tests/test-native-points.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-jev-t3-mod.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-run-band-mod.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-disabled-hooks.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-hook-recursion-guard.sh >/dev/null && echo hooks-ok'
bash -c 'for s in classify-request jev preeval; do /usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/compound-v-$s.py --selftest >/dev/null || { echo FAIL $s; exit 1; }; done; bash tests/test-jev-core.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-native-points.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-hook-recursion-guard.sh >/dev/null && echo py-ok'
bash -c 'bash tests/test-jev-core.sh >/dev/null && bash tests/test-native-points.sh >/dev/null && echo tests-ok'
bash -c 'for s in scripts/compound-v-*.py; do grep -q -- "--selftest" "$s" || continue; /usr/bin/python3 -B "$s" --selftest >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $s"; exit 1; }; done; for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
